98a24: The same problems are some of them [problems] in virtue of having the same
98a25: middle term, e.g., that all [these] involve counter-rotation. Of these, some
98a26: are the same in genus — those that differ by being of different things or in different ways
98a29: (for all involve reflection), but differ in form. Others differ in that the
98a30: middle falls under the other middle — this is how the problems differ,
98a31: e.g., why does the Nile flow more at the waning of the month?
